text: The Ariane 6 #VA271 launch is postponed to no earlier than 24 November.
zh: 欧空局：阿里安6号VA271发射推迟至最早11月24日。

text: Gas prices fall to an 8-month low after 4 weeks of decline, delivering lower prices as Thanksgiving approaches.
zh: 白宫：美国汽油价格连续四周下跌，降至8个月低点，感恩节前出行成本下降。

text: Starlink helps kids with education — quoting @1818311005698678784: Starlink is bringing high-speed internet to thousands of students in rural Honduras, one school at a time. At Escuela Sergio Palacios in El Hatillo, 200 students now have access to Starlink internet through an installation by Conatel, part of a wider effort that has connected 1,212 institutions.
zh: 马斯克：Starlink正在为洪都拉斯农村学校接入高速互联网，当地一所学校200名学生已用上，并纳入更大规模的连通计划。

text: Consciousness is either an illusion or ubiquitous on a gradient. Difficult to argue that carbon is conscious, but silicon is not.
zh: 马斯克：意识要么是幻觉，要么普遍存在于连续谱上；很难论证碳基有意识而硅基没有。

text: This was done without AI/SI, but we will be using a lot of SI in the future — quoting @3167257102: I still can’t get over the fact that this happened. The precision of this, down to sub-meter accuracy when it was traveling at OVER 7,000 m/s.
zh: 马斯克：猎鹰回收目前尚未依靠人工智能或超级智能，却能在超过7000米/秒的速度下实现亚米级精度着陆；未来将大量使用超级智能。

text: 32 hour launch pad recycle. Great work by SpaceX team. — quoting @SpaceX: Falcon 9 and NROL-136 lift off from pad 4E in California 32 hours after teams launched USSF-317, completing our fastest turnaround between launches from the same pad
zh: 马斯克：SpaceX同一发射台在32小时内完成两次发射，创下最快翻台纪录，并称赞团队表现出色。

text: Falcon 9 and NROL-136 lift off from pad 4E in California 32 hours after teams launched USSF-317, completing our fastest turnaround between launches from the same pad
zh: SpaceX：猎鹰9号从加州4E工位发射NROL-136任务，距同工位发射USSF-317仅间隔32小时，创下同台最快翻台纪录。

text: This is the most important thing OpenAI has published in awhile. We are providing a lot of transparency into our pretraining progress and hope we can agree as a frield to common limits. I think that would be very wise and help ensure safety and control. — quoting @1032406226502479872: We decided to provide more transparency into pretraining progress at OpenAI for the sake of moving toward shared safety bars. In “Perplexity and Intelligence” I argue for common limits based on perplexity and other measurements, with progress beyond them gated on our ability to understand AI behavior.
zh: 奥特曼：称这是OpenAI近来最重要的发布，公司正提高预训练进展的透明度，并呼吁业界就共同上限达成一致，以保障安全与可控。

text: Starlink saves lives — quoting @1389913567671975937: Starlink helped rescue an injured hiker stranded in Japan’s mountains with no mobile signal. After a 6-metre fall, he was bleeding heavily, had a broken finger and could no longer walk. He used Starlink to text his wife his exact coordinates. He spent the night under an emergency blanket before rescuers reached him around 10:30 the next morning and arranged a helicopter flight to hospital.
zh: 马斯克：一名徒步者在日本山区坠落受伤且无手机信号，靠Starlink向妻子发送准确坐标后获救。

text: Some people thought we meant 25% improvement, no we mean 25 times! Welcome to the singularity. Hope you’re enjoying your stay. — quoting @1118594454515003393: FSD V15 is 25x safer than V14 I would have guessed V14 is at MINIMUM 2x safer than a human (probably more).
zh: 马斯克：FSD V15安全性提升的是25倍而非25%，并称这标志着奇点已至。

text: Looks like an SI curve — quoting @4375247427: SpaceX has now launched more payload mass to orbit in 20 years than the rest of the US combined since 1957.
zh: 马斯克：SpaceX在约20年内送入轨道的载荷质量，已超过美国其余各方自1957年以来的总和。

text: Tesla FSD V15 is a banger release! Completely new architecture that deserves being called “super” intelligence, as it drives better than human intelligence.
zh: 马斯克：特斯拉FSD V15是一次重大更新，采用全新架构，称其驾驶能力已超过人类智能。

text: This is real-time AI video generation (no gaming engine!) using just half of one AI4 TRIP accelerator. Let that sink in …
zh: 马斯克：实时AI视频生成（非游戏引擎）仅用一枚AI4 TRIP加速器的一半算力即可完成。

text: Splashdown of Dragon confirmed, completing SpaceX’s 35th Commercial Resupply Services mission to the @Space_Station!
zh: SpaceX：龙飞船确认溅落，完成第35次国际空间站商业补给任务（CRS-35）。

text: In FSD V15, the Tesla AI computer re-renders reality with chevrons in the sky for turns like a video game. You can tap any point on the reality revisualizer to make your car go there.
zh: 马斯克：FSD V15中，特斯拉AI电脑会重新渲染现实画面，转向提示像游戏一样显示在空中，点击画面任意点即可让车辆前往。

text: FSD v15 now starting to roll out – upgrading every part of the end-to-end driving network Safety 25x better handling of safety critical cases Tesla Reality View Adds a live visualization of the drive that lets you see & control what FSD is planning to do Navigation for start & end of the trip now learns end-to-end from fleet route preferences. Later v15 releases will expand this to the entire route. You also should notice better detection of signs, animals, debris, potholes and standing water, plus more natural speed handling in school zones and inclement weather. Lastly, FSD can now slow for speed cameras & Bike Rack Mode lets you enable FSD w/ bike racks or similar hitch accessories
zh: 特斯拉：FSD v15开始推送，端到端驾驶网络全面升级，称关键安全场景处理提升25倍，并新增Tesla Reality View实时可视化、起止路段端到端导航学习、测速摄像头减速及自行车架模式等。

text: Simple explanation of the usefulness of the Riemann proof (so far) is that it removes the conditional nature of other math theorems dependent upon it. And, of course, is yet another mind-blowing thing achieved by super intelligence …
zh: 马斯克：黎曼猜想证明的意义在于消除了依赖该猜想的其他数学定理的条件性，并称这是超级智能的又一突破。

text: During his 4 day historic trip to Asia, President Trump met with more than 20 world leaders, secured two new trade deals, attended four major international summits, reaffirmed America's alliances throughout the region, & advanced the cause of peace & security around the world.
zh: 白宫：特朗普为期4天的亚洲之行会见20多位领导人，达成两项新贸易协议，并出席四场大型国际峰会。

text: President Donald J. Trump on a deal with Iran: “I’m not going to let somebody allow them to have a nuclear weapon.”
zh: 白宫：特朗普谈伊朗协议时表示，不会允许伊朗拥有核武器。

text: Falcon 9 launches USSF-317 to orbit from pad 4E in California
zh: SpaceX：猎鹰9号从加州4E工位将美国太空军USSF-317任务送入轨道。

text: Starlink saves lives — quoting @1389913567671975937: Starlink is being deployed to help fight DR Congo’s deadly Ebola outbreak. Africa CDC has donated Starlink kits to health officials in Beni to help frontline teams share critical data in real time and coordinate faster responses, even in remote communities.
zh: 马斯克：非洲疾控中心向刚果（金）埃博拉防疫前线捐赠Starlink套装，以便偏远地区实时共享数据、加快响应。

text: Starlink helps education — quoting @1818311005698678784: SpaceX has donated 1,600 Starlink kits to help connect some of Paraguay's most remote schools to high-speed internet. COPACO has completed the first phase, connecting 800 schools across Paraguay.
zh: 马斯克：SpaceX向巴拉圭偏远学校捐赠1600套Starlink，第一阶段已连通800所学校。

text: We’ve had monkeys playing video while drinking banana smoothies for 5 years. Not a bad life. — quoting @1818311005698678784: How it started vs how it's going. In April 2021, Neuralink showed Pager the macaque playing MindPong with his brain. Now a Neuralink patient is flying a plane in GTA VI with 2 joysticks and 12 buttons of control, all with his brain. Before the implant, he used a mouth stick.
zh: 马斯克：Neuralink患者已能用脑机接口在《GTA VI》中开飞机，控制两个摇杆和12个按钮；公司五年前曾展示猴子用意念玩游戏。
